title: Trustify: Online notarization for Vietnam
transcript:
One workflow for applicants
and notary offices.
notes: Product source: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/README.md. Approved brand: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/docs/brand/brand-identity.md. Screenshot: final/routes/public-home-desktop.png, current October2026 UI. Team project established2025. This deck pitches a future pilot, not a launched regulated service.

title: Document work needs a visible next step
transcript: Document work needs a visible next step
People need to know which documents to bring.
Applicants need to see what the notary needs next.
Issued documents need a clear path back to their records.
Product hypothesis to validate with applicants and licensed notary offices
notes: Problem framing is a product hypothesis drawn from the approved brand brief and the application workflow. No user-research study, measured time saving or market-size claim is asserted.

title: Who Trustify serves
transcript: A shared case connects the people doing the work.
Prepare a hồ sơ công chứng and follow its progress.
Coordinate recurring document work with a notary office.
Review cases, request corrections and manage sessions.
notes: Approved audiences and positioning: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/docs/brand/brand-identity.md. Business use is an intended audience, not a claim that enterprise tenancy or corporate permissions exist.

notes: Notary review implementation and UI evidence: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/docs/design/final/README.md and https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/docs/design/screenshots/final/states/notary-document-review-preview-desktop.png. The screenshot uses a sample document and synthetic QA identities. The deck makes no real throughput or processing-time claim.

title: Document verification with a record to inspect
transcript: Document verification with a record to inspect
Stored off-chain through IPFS and Pinata.
NFT metadata on Solana devnet links the record to the file.
Current integration uses a test network. A blockchain record alone does not establish legal validity.
notes: Blockchain implementation: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Backend/blob/main/src/config/blockchain.js and src/services/notarization.service.js. Verification UI: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend/blob/main/docs/design/screenshots/final/states/public-verify-record-desktop.png. Files are uploaded off-chain to IPFS/Pinata and metadata references are minted on Solana devnet. NFT possession/metadata is not proof of legal validity or complete confidentiality.

title: A working technical foundation
transcript: React 18, Redux Toolkit and Material UI
Vietnamese workspaces for users, notaries and admins
JWT and Google OAuth, with PayOS payments
Devnet NFT minting and file references
notes: Verified against frontend package.json/README and backend package.json, src/config/blockchain.js, src/services/chatbot.service.js and src/services/payment.service.js. Source: https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Frontend and https://github.com/sloweyyy/Trustify-Backend. Gemini supplies procedural guidance, not implemented document generation. PayOS is the implemented payment gateway, not crypto checkout.

title: A business model to validate
transcript: The first commercial question is whether offices will pay for clearer case management.
A proposed recurring fee for workflow tools and case visibility.
A hypothesis to test only where the applicable service and fee rules allow it.
Proposed model. Pricing and willingness to pay remain unvalidated.
notes: Proposed commercial model only. No pricing, paying customers, revenue, funding, market size or validated willingness to pay is claimed. Fee design needs review with licensed notary offices and applicable rules before any offer.

title: A pilot with clear readiness gates
transcript: A pilot with clear readiness gates
Observe applicants and notaries using real tasks in a controlled pilot.
Confirm eligible workflows, identity checks, signing and data handling with qualified partners.
Set a verified fee catalog, support process and production infrastructure requirements.
Proposed next step: agree on pilot scope and success measures with a licensed office.
notes: Forward-looking proposal, not a delivery promise or completed certification. No pilot agreements, user-research findings, regulated signing integrations, mainnet launch or commercial scale are claimed. Source for present capabilities: repo README and docs/design/final/README.md.
